findings.title: No real PostgreSQL migration and independent readback proof
findings.assessment: The frozen receipt records a local fixture run and explicitly states that no real or shared PostgreSQL migration was executed. The supplied PostgreSQL evidence directory contains only a server log, not applied migration output, schema/catalog assertions, data readback, or ledger readback.
findings.required_for_acceptance: Run the frozen migration against an approved isolated PostgreSQL instance and preserve independent SQL/catalog/data/ledger readback for the MA1 acceptance cases.

findings.title: Forward and recovery evidence is absent
findings.assessment: The MA1 acceptance contract requires upgrade, repeat execution, legacy-value ownership backfill, conflict quarantine, no-evidence hiding, and recovery tests. The static tests inspect SQL text and mocked runner behavior only; no forward-recovery or restore/readback result is present in the fixed evidence scope.
findings.required_for_acceptance: Provide an immutable forward/recovery run with before/after and post-recovery readback, including idempotent rerun and quarantine/hidden-state assertions.

findings.title: Fixture provenance cannot support acceptance
findings.assessment: Both the node evidence identity and receipt mark mock_or_fixture=true, evidence_level=local-runtime, environment=local macOS isolated candidate root, account/tenant=n/a, and runtime_release_id=n/a. This is sufficient to retain VERIFIED but is not an independent database acceptance identity.
findings.required_for_acceptance: Bind the database run to an identified approved environment, database identity, timestamp, migration ledger, and independent read-only reviewer evidence.

findings.title: Generated progress narrative conflicts with frozen evidence provenance
findings.assessment: The progress view narrates a real empty-database validation and readback, while the frozen MA1 receipt says no real/shared PostgreSQL migration was executed and the evidence directory has no corresponding readback artifact. The unsupported narrative cannot promote the node.
findings.required_for_acceptance: Resolve the provenance discrepancy with a hash-bound database run artifact; do not use the progress narrative as a substitute for raw readback evidence.

findings.title: Static source checks and frozen hashes are intact
findings.assessment: The MA1 node hash, deterministic receipt hash, and migration source hash match the pinned values. The receipt reports 27 passed and 3 subtests passed. This supports the existing VERIFIED state only and does not satisfy the missing runtime acceptance gates.
